title: 第154章 双向奔赴
slug: 电竞世界冠军选秀c位出道
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

屏幕上白光一闪，出现了那条熟悉的走廊。

本来空无一人的走廊里突然出现了两个一前一后走路的人，镜头放大，拍清了后方江执屿的脸，场下瞬间又响起了一阵尖叫。

镜头里走在前面的工作人员领着江执屿到走廊中段后，就鬼鬼祟祟地离开了，留江执屿一个人沉默地站在那里。

此时的江执屿还没把额发梳起，依然柔顺地垂在额前。

脸上的仿真伤痕在隐藏镜头里若隐若现，整个人完全没有舞台正式露面时桀骜不驯的味道，反而像误入迷途的羔羊。

【这大哥也太做贼心虚了啊啊啊啊啊！】

【要这么明显吗！我看着尴尬癌要犯了哈哈哈哈！】

【啊啊啊啊刘海跟封印似的，有就乖孩子，没有感觉下一秒就要A上来了。】

【就这样自由切换哥弟人格，谁说我们小江不会伪装的！】

镜头边缘，一个脑袋在江执屿视觉盲区探头探脑，随即在同伴的推搡间小心把一个木箱子扛上肩，动作轻飘飘的，仿佛没什么重量。

但当他走出视野盲区，却一下子垮下身子，活像肩负什么沉重的巨物。

然后就这样一步一步蹒跚地靠近站在走廊中段的江执屿。

【大哥好演技，要不是我知道里面是什么我就信了。】

【这个好，这个比刚刚那个鬼鬼祟祟的好！】

【演技吊打某些粉丝吹上天的男演员了。】

【江执屿就这样每天被节目组套路，然后扁扁地走开。】

镜头里的男人靠近江执屿时，很刻意的身子一歪，箱子往侧边滑，随即在观众还没反应过来时便已被眼疾手快的江执屿扶正。

紧接着，就见江执屿很冷静地对把箱子放在地上的男人说出了那句：“隐藏摄像机。”

【拆穿，全部拆穿！】

【大哥：不儿哥们，一点面子不给？】

【你江哥没那么容易上当，毕竟是RXG的大脑呢。】

画面继续推进，男人没窘迫多久，就继续神色自如地开启快问快答环节。

而江执屿关于舞台和应援色的几个回答让观众的心软成一片，弹幕和现场的氛围进一步推高。

随即男人。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

A white light flashed on the screen, and the familiar corridor appeared.

Two people walking one behind the other suddenly appeared in the originally empty corridor. The camera zoomed in and clearly captured the face of Jiang Zhiyu in the back. Another scream erupted from the audience.

In the camera, the staff member walking in front led Jiang Zhiyu to the middle of the corridor and then sneaked away, leaving Jiang Zhiyu standing there alone in silence.

At this time, Jiang Zhiyu had not yet combed his forehead hair, it was still hanging softly in front of his forehead.

The simulated scars on his face are looming in the hidden camera, and his whole person has no rebelliousness at all when he officially appeared on stage. Instead, he looks like a lost lamb.

[This eldest brother is too guilty!】

[Does it have to be so obvious!I look so embarrassed that I am about to get cancer, hahahaha!】

[Ah ah ah ah, my bangs are like a seal. I'm a good boy. I don't feel like I'm going to have an A in the next second.】

[You can switch your brother’s personality freely like this. Who said we, Xiao Jiang, can’t pretend!】

At the edge of the camera, a head poked its head into Jiang Zhiyu's blind spot, and then he carefully lifted a wooden box onto his shoulders while being pushed by his companions. His movements were light and airy, as if it had no weight.

But when he walked out of the blind spot, he suddenly collapsed, as if he was carrying a heavy object.

Then he staggered closer to Jiang Zhiyu, who was standing in the middle of the corridor.

[Brother is good at acting. If I didn’t know what was in it, I would have believed it.】

[This is good, this is better than the sneaky one just now!】

[The acting skills of this actor are beyond praise by some fans.】

[Jiang Zhiyu is tricked by the show crew every day, and then walks away flatly.】

When the man in the camera approached Jiang Zhiyu, he deliberately tilted his body and the box slid sideways. Before the audience could react, he was righted by Jiang Zhiyu, who had quick eyes and quick hands.

Immediately afterwards, Jiang Zhiyu calmly said to the man who put the box on the ground: "Hidden camera."

【Dismantle, dismantle them all!】

[Big brother: No, brother, why don’t you give me any face?】

[You, Brother Jiang, are not so easily fooled. After all, you are the brains of RXG.】

The scene continued to advance, and the man was not embarrassed for long before he continued to start the quick question and answer session with a calm expression.

Jiang Zhiyu's answers about the stage and supporting colors made the audience soften their hearts, and the barrage and the atmosphere of the scene were further enhanced.

Then men.
